common.cropper.title.description: Title of the reusable square photo-crop dialog shown after picking or capturing an image.

common.cropper.hint.value: ज़ूम के लिए पिंच करें, जगह बदलने के लिए खींचें
common.cropper.hint.description: Gesture hint under the crop viewport in the square photo-crop dialog.

common.cropper.confirm.description: Confirm button of the square photo-crop dialog; applies the chosen crop.

common.cropper.image_desc.description: Accessibility description of the image shown inside the crop viewport.

common.camera_missing.value: कोई कैमरा ऐप उपलब्ध नहीं है
common.camera_missing.description: Snackbar/toast shown when a photo-capture button is tapped on a device with no camera app installed.

common.viewer.fullscreen.description: Action icon in the full-screen image viewer: enter immersive full-screen (hides system bars and viewer controls).

common.viewer.exit_fullscreen.description: Action icon in the full-screen image viewer while immersive: restore system bars and viewer controls.

common.viewer.download.description: Action icon in the full-screen image viewer: save a copy of the image to the device's Downloads.

common.viewer.delete.description: Action icon in the full-screen image viewer: delete the shown image (feature decides what delete means).

common.viewer.close.description: Action icon in the full-screen image viewer: close the viewer.

common.viewer.saved_to.description: Snackbar after the viewer's download action succeeds; %1$s is the folder the copy landed in (e.g. Download/Samaroh).

common.viewer.save_failed.description: Snackbar after the viewer's download action fails (no space, denied permission on old Android).
